rows.note: This is the everyday all-purpose noun for a preliminary assumption or conjecture.

example.english: For now, we are working from this presupposition; it may not actually be true.
example.traditional: 我哋而家只係按住呢個假設去計，未必真係咁。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 zi2 hai6 on3 zyu6 ni1 go3 gaa2 cit3 heoi3 gai3 mei6 bit1 zan1 hai6 gam3

rows.note: Use this technical term when the assumption is left implicit in an utterance or other use of language.

example.english: When you say, “He is late again,” the presupposition is that he has been late before.
example.traditional: 你話「佢又遲到喇」，個預設係佢之前都試過遲到。
example.jyutping: nei5 waa6 keoi5 jau6 ci4 dou3 laa3 go3 jyu6 cit3 hai6 keoi5 zi1 cin4 dou1 si3 gwo3 ci4 dou3
